P1:111 also reads 'bye brag tu rang rang gis...' (same text re-ingested; corroborating, not independent). Corpus-wide, 'thogbye' occurs only in C03:499 and 'thog bye brag tu' occurs nowhere, so this is a one-off segmentation fault at the C03 498/499 boundary: the stranded final syllable of 498 was glued to the head of 499.
